state.instructions: Get the price of a blue sweatshirt. Point at the value that the task asks to get, to read it. Then stop.

__tool__.instructions: Which action best advances `instructions`, given `state` and `previous_actions`?

criteria.read_price: Reads the price of the item from the web page, which is the picture in `state.screen`.

read_price.target.instructions: the price of the item that `instructions` ask for, in `state.screen`

read_price.target?present.instructions: Is the price of the item that `instructions` ask for visible in `state.screen`?
